item.tib: mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol las 'khrul pa rtsad bcad yang dag don la 'khor ba'i 'phrul 'khor ye shes rang 'bar
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyud las 'khrul ('phrul) 'khor ye shes rang 'bar zhes bya ba 'di ni/ tshe 'di blos btang zhing phyi ma'i don du gnyer ba'i nyams len pa rtogs ldan pra dz+nya tshul mi la sogs slob ma 'ga' yis bskul ba la brten nas/ shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams khro chen rgyal po'i mnga' ris su dus rtag tu ma tshogs mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin du gtib pa'i gnas mchog ke'u nyi ma rang shar gyi gnas su/ thos chung kun grol grags pa bdag gis sa rta zla ba drug pa'i 'phel phyogs su brtsams pa dge legs rgya mtsho'i rgyu ru gyur cig
